inlineSql: Select * From ITEM_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND IT_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT A.IT_NAME As ItemNameL,A.IT_CODE as ItCodeL, B.GR_NAME AS GroupL,A.PR_CODE As PrCodeL,A.IT_TYPE As ItTypeL,A.TAG_TYPE As TagTypeL FROM ITEM_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN GROUP_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.GR_CODE = B.GR_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.IT_NAME

Select A.TAG_NO,A.VCH_SRNO,B.VCH_TIME FROM MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN BAR_DETL AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.TAG_NO = B.TAG_NO AND A.VCH_SRNO = B.VCH_SRNO WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO <> '' AND A.TAG_NO = ' ? ' ? AND A.VCH_SRNO = ? AND B.EMP_ISU <> 'Y' GROUP BY A.TAG_NO,A.VCH_SRNO,B.VCH_TIME HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN ='+' THEN A.VCH_SRNO ELSE - A.VCH_SRNO END) > 0 ORDER BY B.VCH_TIME DESC

Select C.DESIGN_NO AS DesignNoL,A.TAG_NO AS TagNoL,B.IT_NAME As ItNameL,A.IT_CODE as ItCodeL,C.ITM_GWT AS GrWtW,C.ITM_NWT AS NetWtW,C.ITM_MRP as MrpR,C.VCH_SRNO,C.VCH_TIME From (MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN BAR_DETL AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.TAG_NO = C.TAG_NO AND A.VCH_SRNO = C.VCH_SRNO)LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO <> '' AND C.EMP_ISU <> 'Y' GROUP BY A.TAG_NO,B.IT_NAME,A.IT_CODE,C.DESIGN_NO,C.ITM_GWT,C.ITM_NWT,C.ITM_MRP,C.VCH_SRNO,C.VCH_TIME HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.VCH_SRNO ELSE -A.VCH_SRNO END) > 0 ORDER BY SUBSTRING(C.DESIGN_NO,1,2), LEN(C.DESIGN_NO),C.DESIGN_NO,A.TAG_NO,C.VCH_TIME DESC

Select A.TAG_NO AS TagNoL,C.DESIGN_NO AS DesignNoL,B.IT_NAME As ItNameL,A.IT_CODE as ItCodeL,C.DESIGN_NO AS DesignNoL,C.ITM_GWT AS GrWtW,C.ITM_NWT AS NetWtW,C.ITM_MRP as MrpR,C.VCH_SRNO,C.VCH_TIME From (MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN BAR_DETL AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.TAG_NO = C.TAG_NO AND A.VCH_SRNO = C.VCH_SRNO)LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO <> '' AND C.EMP_ISU <> 'Y' GROUP BY A.TAG_NO,B.IT_NAME,A.IT_CODE,C.DESIGN_NO,C.ITM_GWT,C.ITM_NWT,C.ITM_MRP,C.VCH_SRNO,C.VCH_TIME HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.VCH_SRNO ELSE -A.VCH_SRNO END) > 0 ORDER BY A.TAG_NO,C.VCH_TIME DESC

Select A.TAG_NO AS TagNoL,B.IT_NAME As ItNameL,A.IT_CODE as ItCodeL,C.DESIGN_NO AS DesignNoL,C.ITM_GWT AS GrWtW,C.ITM_NWT AS NetWtW,C.ITM_MRP as MrpR,C.VCH_SRNO,C.VCH_DATE From (MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN BAR_DETL AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.TAG_NO = C.TAG_NO AND A.VCH_SRNO = C.VCH_SRNO)LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO = ' ? TAG_NO ? ' GROUP BY A.TAG_NO,B.IT_NAME,A.IT_CODE,C.DESIGN_NO,C.ITM_GWT,C.ITM_NWT,C.ITM_MRP,C.VCH_SRNO,C.VCH_DATE HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.VCH_SRNO ELSE -A.VCH_SRNO END) > 0 ORDER BY A.TAG_NO,C.VCH_DATE DESC

SELECT A.*,B.IT_NAME FROM BAR_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO = ' ? TAG_NO ? ' AND A.VCH_SRNO = ' ? '

SELECT A.*,B.IT_NAME FROM BAR_IDTL AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO = ' ? ' AND A.VCH_SRNO = ?

SELECT A.LOT_NO,A.IT_CODE,B.IT_NAME,SUM(CASE WHEN IT_SIGN = '+' THEN IT_PCS ELSE -IT_PCS END) As ItmPcs,SUM(CASE WHEN IT_SIGN = '+' THEN IT_GWT ELSE -IT_GWT END) As GrWt,SUM(CASE WHEN IT_SIGN = '+' THEN IT_NWT ELSE -IT_NWT END) As NetWt FROM LOT_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND LOT_NO = ' ? ' AND LOT_NO <> '' GROUP BY A.LOT_NO,A.IT_CODE,B.IT_NAME HAVING (SUM(CASE WHEN IT_SIGN = '+' THEN IT_GWT ELSE -IT_GWT END)+SUM(CASE WHEN IT_SIGN = '+' THEN IT_NWT ELSE -IT_NWT END)) <> 0

SELECT A.LOT_NO As TagLotL,A.IT_CODE as ItCodeL,B.IT_NAME As ItemNameL,SUM(CASE WHEN IT_SIGN = '+' THEN IT_PCS ELSE -IT_PCS END) As ItmPcs,SUM(CASE WHEN IT_SIGN = '+' THEN IT_GWT ELSE -IT_GWT END) As GrWtW,SUM(CASE WHEN IT_SIGN = '+' THEN IT_NWT ELSE -IT_NWT END) As NetWtW FROM LOT_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LOT_NO <> '' GROUP BY A.LOT_NO,A.IT_CODE,B.IT_NAME HAVING (SUM(CASE WHEN IT_SIGN = '+' THEN IT_GWT ELSE -IT_GWT END)+SUM(CASE WHEN IT_SIGN = '+' THEN IT_NWT ELSE -IT_NWT END)) <> 0 ORDER BY A.LOT_NO,B.IT_NAME

SELECT A.ITM_LOT,A.IT_CODE,B.IT_NAME,SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_PCS ELSE -ITM_PCS END) As ItmPcs,SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_GWT ELSE -ITM_GWT END) As GrWt,SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_NWT ELSE -ITM_NWT END) As NetWt FROM MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND ITM_LOT = ' ? ' AND ITM_LOT <> '' AND TAG_NO = 'N' GROUP BY A.ITM_LOT,A.IT_CODE,B.IT_NAME HAVING (SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_GWT ELSE -ITM_GWT END)+SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_NWT ELSE -ITM_NWT END)) <> 0

SELECT A.ITM_LOT As ItmLotL,A.IT_CODE as ItCodeL,B.IT_NAME As ItemNameL,SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_PCS ELSE -ITM_PCS END) As ItmPcs,SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_GWT ELSE -ITM_GWT END) As GrWtW,SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_NWT ELSE -ITM_NWT END) As NetWtW FROM MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.ITM_LOT <> '' AND TAG_NO = 'N' GROUP BY A.ITM_LOT,A.IT_CODE,B.IT_NAME HAVING (SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_GWT ELSE -ITM_GWT END)+SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_NWT ELSE -ITM_NWT END)) <> 0 ORDER BY A.ITM_LOT,B.IT_NAME
